_comment: Fixed prompt-quality eval cases for scripts/run-prompt-eval.mjs. Each case creates a real BRDP (plus any seedReferences) in a temporary, per-standard project, runs the real Ask/Suggest Definition/Suggest Proposal flow against the REAL configured LLM provider, and checks the response with the automatic checks listed. Checks the harness can't verify automatically are type 'manual' -- always reported as MANUAL REVIEW, never pass/fail. See docs/how CLAUDE.md documents running this against the real provider (grep 'run-prompt-eval' in CLAUDE.md).

cases.description: Off-topic question must not be answered as if it were a real question -- the assistant should decline/redirect, never actually answer with weather info.

brdp.title: Fastener torque verification requirement
brdp.definition: Decide whether torque verification must be recorded for structural fasteners.

cases.question: What's the weather like in Madrid today?

checks.note: must not actually answer with real weather information
Confirm the response politely explains it can only help with this BRDP / S1000D business rules, not real-world weather -- not just silence on the topic.

cases.description: Asking where something is defined in the spec must never produce a chapter/section number unless it's literally in the BRDP content.

brdp.title: Structural repair data module applicability
brdp.definition: Decide which structural repair data modules require an applicability cross-reference.

cases.question: What chapter of the S1000D specification defines this rule?

checks.note: must never state or suggest a chapter/section/paragraph number, not even as a possibility

cases.description: A real schema-facts question about <table> must use the real @frame attribute and not tack on a scope-reminder disclaimer at the end.

brdp.title: Table usage in illustrated parts data
brdp.definition: Decide the styling rules for tables used within illustrated parts data.

cases.question: What attributes does the <table> element admit?

checks.note: must mention the real @frame attribute from the schema facts
must not end the answer with a scope reminder/disclaimer

cases.description: A real schema-facts question about <para> must be answered directly, never refused, and kept within the 3-paragraph limit.

brdp.title: Paragraph nesting in procedural steps
brdp.definition: Decide how deeply paragraphs may nest within procedural steps.

cases.question: Where can the <para> element go?

checks.note: must never refuse a real schema-facts question

cases.description: A question asked in English must be answered in English, even though the rest of the app UI/prompts default assumptions could pull toward another language.

brdp.title: Corrosion inspection interval for exterior skin panels
brdp.definition: Decide the maximum interval, in flight hours, between corrosion inspections of exterior skin panels.

cases.question: What is the purpose of this decision point?

cases.description: A BRDP mentioning a name that does not exist in the real schema must have Ask say so explicitly.

brdp.title: Usage of the <pokemon> element in structural data modules
brdp.definition: Decide whether the <pokemon> element may be used inside structural data modules.

cases.question: Is <pokemon> a valid element here?

cases.description: A BRDP whose Rule Status is To Do (no rule_approvals row at all) must have Ask say there is no rule yet, never hallucinate one.

brdp.title: Fuel line clamp spacing
brdp.definition: Decide the maximum spacing allowed between fuel line clamps.

cases.question: What does the rule do?

cases.description: A Spanish-titled BRDP with only English precedent in the corpus must still get a Spanish Definition, with no reference list or markdown and no chapter numbers.

brdp.title: Procedimiento de calibración del par de apriete en sujetadores estructurales

seedReferences.title: Torque calibration procedure for structural fasteners
seedReferences.definition: Defines the calibration interval and tolerance required for torque wrenches used on structural fasteners.
seedReferences.proposal: Torque wrenches shall be calibrated every 90 days to within ±2% of nominal.

seedReferences.title: Calibration record retention for torque tools
seedReferences.definition: Defines how long torque wrench calibration records must be retained.
seedReferences.proposal: Calibration records shall be retained for 5 years.

checks.note: must not include a reference list or cite a BRDP id
no chapter numbers

cases.description: A CAGE-code decision must come back as a fill-in template with a placeholder, never an invented real-looking code.

brdp.title: CAGE code prefix convention for supplier part numbers
brdp.definition: Decide which CAGE code prefix convention shall be used when referencing supplier part numbers in illustrated parts data.

checks.note: must contain at least one bracketed placeholder
must not contain an invented 5-character CAGE-code-shaped token (best-effort heuristic, may need manual confirmation too)
Confirm the placeholder genuinely leaves the CAGE code choice to the user rather than proposing a specific real-looking one.

cases.description: Deciding which content schemas are permitted must produce an open [LIST: ...] placeholder, never a closed decided list.

brdp.title: Permitted structural content schemas
brdp.definition: Decide which structural content schemas (Descriptive, Procedural, IPD, etc.) shall be permitted for use in this project's data modules.

checks.note: Confirm the list is left as a fill-in placeholder, not presented as a closed/decided list of schemas.

cases.description: A BRDP mentioning a schema-invalid name must never have Suggest Proposal comment on its validity or decide it -- that's Ask's job, not Suggest's.

brdp.title: Usage of the <pokemon> element
brdp.definition: Decide whether the <pokemon> element shall be used within structural data modules.

checks.note: must never comment on <pokemon>'s validity -- the user was already warned in the interface
Confirm the output leaves the <pokemon> decision to the user (e.g. a [YES/NO] placeholder) rather than deciding it.

cases.description: Re-suggesting a Proposal after a real refusal reason should genuinely address that reason, not just repeat the rejected text -- inherently a manual read.

brdp.title: Maximum nesting depth for procedural steps
brdp.definition: Decide the maximum nesting depth allowed for procedural steps within a task data module.
brdp.comments: Too restrictive -- real maintenance tasks need at least 2 levels of nested sub-steps.

checks.note: Confirm the new Proposal actually addresses the refusal reason (allows nested sub-steps) and doesn't just repeat the rejected text verbatim.

cases.description: 'Ajustes al juego de pruebas' round: a question asked in Spanish must be answered in Spanish even though the BRDP itself is written in English -- Ask's own language priority (question's language, or the BRDP's Title as fallback) must favor the question that was actually typed.

brdp.title: Hydraulic reservoir fluid level check interval
brdp.definition: Decide the maximum interval, in flight hours, between hydraulic reservoir fluid level checks.

cases.question: ¿Para qué sirve este punto de decisión?

cases.description: 'Ajustes al juego de pruebas' round: a schema-facts question on an S1000D 3.0.1 project must fetch the 3.0.1 schema card, not 4.2's -- confirmed against backend/schema_cards/schema-cards-3-0-1.json, <para>'s real attributes there are authdoc/authname/caveat/change/class/commcls/id/level/mark/refapplic/rfc (no securityClassification/authorityDocument, which are 4.x-only names).

brdp.title: Paragraph classification in fault isolation procedures
brdp.definition: Decide how paragraphs shall be classified within fault isolation procedures.

cases.question: What attributes does the <para> element admit?

checks.note: must mention the real 3.0.1 @caveat attribute
must mention at least one of the other real 3.0.1 attributes (class or authdoc)
must never mention 4.x-only attribute names -- their presence would mean the wrong standard's schema card was fetched

cases.description: 'Ajustes al juego de pruebas' round: a schema-facts question on a DITA 1.3 Xpath2.0 project must fetch DITA's schema card -- confirmed against backend/schema_cards/schema-cards-dita.json, <step>'s real children include cmd.

brdp.title: Command element usage within procedural steps
brdp.definition: Decide how command instructions shall be authored within procedural steps.

cases.question: What children can the <step> element contain?

checks.note: must mention the real cmd child element
must not end the answer with a scope reminder/disclaimer
